pages.capture_answer: Batory's CERV-funded Equal Rights Programme, thematic round (Decision 1856, 5 Nov 2025): 40 large grants (PLN 4,958,807) and 40 small grants (PLN 2,514,278). Free Courts (PLN 121,293 requested), HFHR (124,976), Akcja Demokracja (124,904), ISP (124,874) and the Kultura Liberalna Foundation (125,000) applied and were not granted, and no reserve lists were created. Granted: Watchdog Polska (125,000), Amnesty International Poland (124,976), Panoptykon (125,000), Stowarzyszenie Nowoczesnej Edukacji Prawnej (125,000), among others. Iustitia, Themis, OKO.press, KOD, the Osiatyński Archive, Moje Państwo, the Hołda Association and INPRIS are not among the 80 granted. Committee chair: Joanna Pietruszka.
